title: Motion (Padilla – Hutt) relative to a breakdown of investment in boys’ sports compared to girls’ sports, the number of contracted sports organizations…
text:
[Council File 26-0337]
Motion (Padilla – Hutt) relative to a breakdown of investment in boys’ sports compared to girls’ sports, the number of contracted sports organizations catering to boys versus those catering to girls; and, an overview of the formal process for groups to apply for and secure field space, with a specific focus on addressing the "waitlist" system.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Motion requesting a breakdown of investment in boys' sports compared to girls' sports and an overview of the field space application and "waitlist" system.

outcome.text: Arts, Parks, and City Facilities Committee approved item(s) (Oct 7, 2026)
